messages:
elena: Quick consolidation from today's control-plane-induced auth storm. Collecting owners + realistic timelines so we can stop the retry-amplification loop.
ops-bot: Incident created: 2026-07-12-P2  runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-07-12 :spiral_note_pad:
mika: short RCA: upstream control-plane throttled with bursts of 429/500 -> our token refresh retrier kept hammering model-registry -> registry TTL fallback was unset (0s) so everyone renewed immediately -> regional capacity saturated.
raj: concrete proposal list (owners + rough ETA):
- PM-REG-001: client-side per-tenant leaky-bucket + exp backoff (owner: raj, eta: 2026-07-20, est: 10h)
- PM-REG-002: registry safe-TTL floor + circuit-breaker on auth errors (owner: mika, eta: 2026-07-26, est: 14h)
- PM-REG-003: multi-region canary that exercises token refresh + model pull (owner: annie, PoC: 2026-07-15, rollout: 2026-07-30, est: 6h)
- PM-REG-004: CI fault-injection test for control-plane 5xx/429 (owner: elena, eta: 2026-07-22, est: 5h)
- PM-REG-005: vendor SLA escalation & request for control-plane mitigation plan + on-call contact (owner: carl, eta: 2026-07-29)
- PM-REG-006: alerting: surface token-refresh P99 > 2s and circuit-breaker open counts (owner: elena, eta: 2026-07-18, est: 2h)
carl: +1 to vendor escalation. I'll ask for their internal incident timeline and propose a quarterly joint drill. Marking correspondence sensitive in tracker.
annie: canary design note: lightweight lambda in each region posts to /refresh and then requests a tiny model pull. PoC snippet: ```curl -s -X POST https://registry.int/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" -d '{}' && curl -s https://registry.int/models/ping``` runs every 5m.
elena: on recurring pattern: ops shows similar auth blips during vendor maint windows on 4 of last 7 months. we should add a monthly "auth-path resilience" drill owned by ops-sre rotation. first drill: 2026-08-03.
mika: CI test will mock control-plane 429/5xx and assert client backs off and registry circuit opens. Example test pseudocode in PR.
raj: quick clarification: PM-REG-002 will be a config + feature-flag change; no DB migration required. we'll gate on the canary.
ops-bot: Linked incident to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-07-controlplane-blip :link:
elena: I'll host a weekly 20m remediation triage (Wed 09:00 PT) until PM-REG-001/002/003 are green. please add hours to tracker so PM can decide sprint pull vs hotfix sprint. tracker link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/pm-reg-2026-07 (internal-only).
carl: vendor ask: request durable escalation contact and soft throttle options or per-tenant queues. ETA to vendor: 10 business days.
annie: PoC estimates: PM-REG-003 PoC 6h; rollout will need coordination with infra for canary VPC endpoints.
elena: alerting tweak (PM-REG-006) will add a dashboard and an automated PagerDuty rule if circuit-breaker opens in >1 region.
mika: PM-REG-002 hours: 14h. PM-REG-006 hours: 2h.
raj: PM-REG-001 hours: 10h. PM-REG-004 hours: 5h.
carl: noted. I'll drop vendor ticket id into tracker (sensitive).
elena: final: please react with :white_check_mark: in the tracker when ETAs/hours confirmed. I'll close this Slack thread after tracker is canonical and triage invite is accepted.
all: :white_check_mark:
